systems.name: Commodore 64
systems.blurb: VICE, the breadbin, and whatever is in the disk drive.
systems.installHint: Looks for the c64 command, then x64sc, then Flatpak net.sf.VICE.

systems.name: Apple II
systems.blurb: LinApple with the Disk II. Power on boots the master disk.
systems.installHint: Looks for the apple2 command, which starts LinApple.

systems.name: TI-99/4A
systems.blurb: Libre99 with its own console firmware. Cartridges and disks both work.
systems.installHint: Looks for the ti99 command, which starts Libre99.

systems.name: Amiga
systems.blurb: FS-UAE as an A500. Power on uses the built-in AROS ROM. Add a Kickstart you own to boot original disks.
systems.biosNote: Point this at a Kickstart ROM from an Amiga you own, or at an AROS ROM. It is used for every Amiga launch.
systems.installHint: Installs Flatpak net.fsuae.FS-UAE, or uses fs-uae if it is already on PATH.

systems.name: Atari ST
systems.blurb: Hatari. EmuTOS is built in, so a TOS image is optional.
systems.biosNote: Leave this empty to use Hatari's bundled EmuTOS. Add a TOS image here if you have one.
systems.installHint: Installs Flatpak org.tuxfamily.hatari, or uses hatari if it is already on PATH.

games.title: Drift

games.title: Wizball
games.blurb: Roll through grey levels and bring the colour back.

games.title: The Last Ninja

games.title: Elite
